description: This file defines the PdfGoToAction class, which represents a PDF 'GoTo' action in the PDFsharp library. It provides mechanisms to create and initialize a link within a PDF document that jumps to a specified destination.

classes.name: PdfGoToAction
classes.description: Represents a PDF Goto action, allowing navigation to a specific destination within a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfGoToAction
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the PdfGoToAction instance.

methods.name: PdfGoToAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PdfGoToAction with a specific PdfDocument.

methods.name: CreateGoToAction
methods.description: Static factory method to create a PdfGoToAction with a specified destination name.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Overrides method to write the action object to a PDF writer, including setting the destination name.

methods.name: Inititalize
methods.description: Initializes the action's dictionary elements with standard keys for a PDF GoTo action.
